summary: Uncharted entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune

emulation.notes: Use PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. RPCS3 is only a preservation comparison route for the PS3 original.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 remaster at 1080p/60fps, playable through PS5 backward compatibility

primary.version: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection remaster
primary.why: Drake's Fortune was originally a PS3 single-player game, and The Nathan Drake Collection remasters the campaign at 1080p/60fps with improved visuals, controls, and presentation and no multiplayer content to lose for this entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Nathan Drake Collection on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility for the campaign; use the PS3 original only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collection changes aiming, grenade controls, camera/control schemes, and visuals; keep PS3 only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves
entries.definitive_edition: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection for campaign; PS3 original for historical multiplayer reference

emulation.notes: Use PS4/PS5 backward compatibility for the campaign; RPCS3/PS3 preservation research is secondary-only and cannot restore official servers by itself.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 remaster at 1080p/60fps, playable through PS5 backward compatibility

primary.version: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection remaster
primary.why: The Nathan Drake Collection is the highest-fidelity campaign route for Uncharted 2 at 1080p/60fps with visual and control improvements, but it omits the original PS3 multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the remastered campaign on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility; treat the PS3 multiplayer as historical/preservation-only because Naughty Dog shut down the PS3 servers in 2019.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original competitive and cooperative multiplayer modes, including co-op modes such as Gold Rush, Survival, and Siege, absent from The Nathan Drake Collection.
secondary.what_to_play: No normal official server route remains after the 2019 shutdown; document existing captures or use preservation/private-server research only if verified.
secondary.why: The remaster omits Uncharted 2 multiplayer, while the PS3 original had multiplayer content before server shutdown.

entries.remaster_caveats: The collection contains only single-player story modes and excludes Uncharted 2 multiplayer.

primary.version: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection remaster
primary.why: The Nathan Drake Collection is the highest-fidelity campaign route for Uncharted 3 at 1080p/60fps with visual and control improvements, but it omits the original PS3 multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the remastered campaign on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility; treat the PS3 multiplayer as historical/preservation-only because Naughty Dog shut down the PS3 servers in 2019.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original competitive and cooperative multiplayer with character customization, co-op returning from Uncharted 2, and PS3-era online systems absent from The Nathan Drake Collection.
secondary.what_to_play: No normal official server route remains after the 2019 shutdown; document existing captures or use preservation/private-server research only if verified.
secondary.why: The remaster omits Uncharted 3 multiplayer, while the PS3 original had multiplayer content before server shutdown.

entries.remaster_caveats: The collection contains only single-player story modes and excludes Uncharted 3 multiplayer.

entries.title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
entries.definitive_edition: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection on Windows for campaign; PS4 original for multiplayer

emulation.notes: Use native Windows for the primary route; use PS4 hardware/PS5 backward compatibility for multiplayer-only secondary access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC 4K/60 Ultra target with PC graphics options

primary.why: The Windows Legacy of Thieves release is the highest-fidelity campaign route, with official PC features and 4K/60 Ultra-spec support; the PS4 original remains secondary because the remastered collection omits the original multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Legacy of Thieves Collection on a PC meeting the Ultra target for 4K/60 if possible; use the PS4 original only for multiplayer access that the remaster does not include.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Uncharted 4 online multiplayer, including competitive modes and cooperative Survival, absent from Legacy of Thieves Collection.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the PS4 multiplayer/survival content if it is still accessible through the PS4 version; play the campaign on Windows.
secondary.why: PlayStation's Legacy of Thieves FAQ says the remaster does not support the original multiplayer and directs players to the PS4 versions for it.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy of Thieves includes the single-player stories of Uncharted 4 and The Lost Legacy, but does not support the multiplayer from the original titles.

entries.title: Uncharted: Fight for Fortune
entries.definitive_edition: Original PlayStation Vita release plus preserved DLC

emulation.notes: Use original Vita/PSTV hardware first; Vita3K may be useful for preservation only after compatibility checks.

primary.version: Original PlayStation Vita release with DLC packs where preserved
primary.why: Fight for Fortune is a PlayStation Vita digital collectible card spin-off with no later platform release; its DLC packs add cards themed after Uncharted 2 and Uncharted 3, while online multiplayer was shut down in 2019.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Vita/PSTV with the game and DLC already installed or preserved; expect single-player/offline play because online multiplayer services were closed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or port is sourced; online multiplayer closed in 2019 and DLC availability depends on prior ownership/preservation.

entries.title: Uncharted: Fortune Hunter

emulation.notes: Prefer a preserved Android device/install; emulator capture depends on compatibility with the discontinued app.

primary.why: Fortune Hunter launched for Android and iOS as a free-to-play puzzle companion to Uncharted 4, then was discontinued and removed from stores in 2022; Android is the practical preservation/capture primary if a previously downloaded or preserved install is available.
primary.how_to_play: Use a previously downloaded Android install or preserved Android device/build for offline play; do not expect normal App Store or Google Play availability after discontinuation.

entries.remaster_caveats: The app was officially discontinued in March 2022; in-app purchases were disabled, and only previously downloaded copies can continue offline.

entries.title: Uncharted: Golden Abyss

emulation.notes: Original Vita hardware is preferred because motion, touch, and back-touch inputs are part of the design.

primary.why: Golden Abyss is a Vita-exclusive prequel that was left out of The Nathan Drake Collection; original Vita hardware preserves its touch, motion, camera/photography, and back-touch functions.
primary.how_to_play: Use PlayStation Vita or PSTV where compatible for the main route; Vita3K is a preservation fallback only after touch, motion, and camera-related functions are verified.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or port is sourced; the game remains exclusive to Vita and was left out of The Nathan Drake Collection.

entries.title: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy
entries.definitive_edition: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection on Windows for story; PS4 original for multiplayer

emulation.notes: Use native Windows for the primary route; use PS4 hardware/PS5 backward compatibility for multiplayer-only secondary access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC 4K/60 Ultra target with PC graphics options

primary.why: The Windows Legacy of Thieves release is the highest-fidelity campaign route for The Lost Legacy, with PC options and 4K/60 Ultra-spec support; the PS4 original remains secondary because it gives access to multiplayer content omitted from the remaster.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Legacy of Thieves Collection on a PC meeting the Ultra target for 4K/60 if possible; use the PS4 version only for multiplayer access tied to the original release.

secondary.exclusive_content: Access to Uncharted 4 multiplayer with additional content tied to The Lost Legacy, absent from Legacy of Thieves Collection.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the PS4 multiplayer content if still accessible; play the story campaign on Windows.
secondary.why: The Lost Legacy's original PS4 release gives multiplayer access, while Legacy of Thieves does not support the original multiplayer.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy of Thieves includes the single-player stories of Uncharted 4 and The Lost Legacy, but does not support the multiplayer from the original titles.
